cards.text: The LORD gives Moses, Israel's leader, and Aaron the priest a job: count the Kohathites, one of the clans of the Levites. Not every Kohathite, though. Only the men qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

cards.question: Which Kohathite men get counted for the work at the Tent of Meeting?

answers.text: Men from thirty to fifty years old
Men from twenty to sixty years old
Men twenty years old or more

cards.text: The LORD says this Kohathite work regards the most holy things. Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, cover the ark with the veil of the curtain, then wrap the table of the Presence, the lampstand, the gold altar, the utensils and the bronze altar in colored cloth and fine leather, with poles or a carrying frame. Friend, I pack cookie boxes with my MUSTACHE, and I have never wrapped anything like this.
When Aaron and his sons finish covering the holy objects and the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites finally come.

cards.question: Everything's wrapped and the camp is ready to move. Then the Kohathites come and do the ___.
The Kohathites can touch the holy objects as long as they're careful.

cards.text: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest oversees the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering and the anointing oil.

cards.question: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest oversees the oils, the incense and the grain offering. What else is he over?

answers.text: The entire tabernacle and everything in it
The training of the men for battle
The food and water for the whole camp

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses and Aaron again: "Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites."

cards.question: The LORD wants the Kohathites to live when they come near the most holy things. What are Aaron and his sons to do for them?

answers.text: Go in and assign each man his task
Teach them to wrap the holy objects
Lead them in carrying only at night

cards.question: The LORD says that if the Kohathites go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, they will die.

cards.text: Next the LORD tells Moses to count the Gershonites, another clan of the Levites, from thirty to fifty years old. Same ages as the Kohathites, and here I am, still trying to get two batches of cookies to come out the same.

cards.question: The Kohathites carry the holy objects. What do the Gershonites carry?

cards.text: Their ropes and all the equipment for their service go with them too. Whatever needs doing with these items, the Gershonites do it.

cards.question: The Gershonites decide for themselves what each man carries.

cards.text: Their duties are under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest. Then the LORD turns to the sons of Merari, the Merarites, one more clan of the Levites, to be numbered from thirty to fifty years old.

cards.question: The Kohathites have the holy objects and the Gershonites have the curtains. What do the Merarites carry?
The Merarites have a lot of pieces to haul. How do they know which items are theirs to carry?

answers.text: Each item is assigned by name
Each man picks what he wants

cards.question: The Merarites work under the direction of Ithamar, the same son of Aaron who directs the Gershonites.

cards.text: Then Moses, Aaron and the leaders count all three clans, clan by clan, every man from thirty to fifty who came to serve at the Tent of Meeting. I lose count of chocolate chips somewhere around seven.

cards.question: Once all the Levites are counted, only the Kohathite men are assigned work.

cards.text: All of it just as the LORD commanded Moses. And friend, after years in the back of a junk drawer, I know EXACTLY what it feels like to finally get handed a job.
